l-e-h2-b01-10.title: Ti kiri "Whichever" na "Whatever"

l-e-h2-b01-10.s.s1.r.a: Ti yeke pluriel a fa so a sara na "Whichever" gï pëpe.
l-e-h2-b01-10.s.s1.o.b: So ye so mo gbu ni a yeke na yâ ti 2 so a zia ni awe
l-e-h2-b01-10.s.s1.r.c: Atâa sujet ayeke "you", a lingbi ti sara na ye 2 kue.

l-e-h2-b01-10.s.s1.r.d: Point a yeke na tënë na choix ti mot relatif pëpe.
l-e-h2-b01-10.s.s1.explain: Tongana ndo ti choix a zia ni awe, tongana "of the two roads", a sara na famille ti "which". A sara na "Whatever" tongana ndo ayeke ouvert.

l-e-h2-b02-06.s.s1.o.b: Tongana singer ayeke singulier wala pluriel

l-e-h2-b02-06.s.s1.r.d: Ngoi asa décision tongana ordre a inverser wala ape.
l-e-h2-b02-06.s.s1.explain: Tongana Not only aga na kozo kâ kâ ti clause, verbe auxiliaire atambela na kozo ti sujet. Ni la Not only did the singer arrive ayeke tâ.
l-e-h2-b02-06.s.s2.model.0: Tongana Not only ayeke na kozo ti clause, ordre a inverser, ni la place so ayeke information so mo ye.
l-e-h2-b02-06.s.s2.model.1: Nömörö singulier wala ngoi asara inversion ape, ni la ye ti kota ayeke so Not only ayeke na kozo kâ kâ.

l-e-h2-b03-06.title: Critère so asara séparation tî Neither na So
l-e-h2-b03-06.goal: Tî hînga ye so mo tene tî "mbi nga", sï critère (information) wa a bezoin tâ, na fa ndali wa mo sï ni.
l-e-h2-b03-06.material: Mo aye tî kiri na 'I don't like coffee.' na "mbi nga". Décider ôko wa ayeke correct, 'Neither do I.' wala 'So do I.'

l-e-h2-b03-06.s.s1.r.a: Position tî I ayeke même, na ni ayeke critère tî sï ape.
l-e-h2-b03-06.s.s1.o.b: So phrase tî kozo ayeke positive wala négative
l-e-h2-b03-06.s.s1.o.c: Conversation ayeke na phrases mingi tongana nyen
l-e-h2-b03-06.s.s1.r.c: Nömörö tî phrases ayeke na importance ape.

l-e-h2-b03-06.s.s1.explain: Tongana phrase tî kozo ayeke négative (don't), ni afa "mbi nga ape", ndali ni sara kua na Neither. Tongana ni ayeke positive, sara kua na So.
l-e-h2-b03-06.s.s2.model.0: Phrase tî kozo ayeke négative, ndali ni Neither, so apiquer même négatif, alingbi tî a sara kua na ni, na information so a bezoin tâ.
l-e-h2-b03-06.s.s2.model.1: Nömörö tî phrases wala sorte tî nom achanger kiri ape, ndali ni so phrase tî kozo ayeke positive wala négative ayeke critère.

l-e-h2-b03-07.title: Critère so asara séparation tî phrase principale
l-e-h2-b03-07.goal: Tî hînga lege tî sï phrase principale, sï critère (information) wa a bezoin tâ, na fa ndali wa mo sï ni.
l-e-h2-b03-07.material: Bees help food grow. They carry pollen between flowers. Without bees, many crops would fail. Mo aye tî sï phrase principale na yâ tî texte so.
l-e-h2-b03-07.s.s1.prompt: Information wa a bezoin tâ tî décider phrase principale?
l-e-h2-b03-07.s.s1.o.a: So phrase ayeke na mot ngangu
l-e-h2-b03-07.s.s1.r.a: Ngangu tî mot ayeke na rapport ape na contenu principal.
l-e-h2-b03-07.s.s1.o.b: So ni ayeke na kozo mingi
l-e-h2-b03-07.s.s1.r.b: Position gï adécider phrase principale ape.
l-e-h2-b03-07.s.s1.o.c: So phrases nde aexpliquer phrase so
l-e-h2-b03-07.s.s1.r.d: Longueur ayeke na rapport ape na contenu principal.
l-e-h2-b03-07.s.s1.explain: Phrase principale ayeke ye so phrases nde aexpliquer na asoutenir. A décider ni na position wala longueur ape.
l-e-h2-b03-07.s.s2.model.0: Tongana mo bâ so phrases so angbâ aexpliquer phrase so wala pëpe, mo hînga phrase principale, ndali ni information so a bezoin tâ.
l-e-h2-b03-07.s.s2.model.1: Ayeke kozo asara so phrase ayeke phrase principale ngbii kûê ape, ndali ni ye so phrases nde asoutenir ayeke critère.

l-e-h2-b04-11.material: Here comes the bus. / Here it comes. / Down the hill rolled the ball. / Down the hill it rolled. Wara règle ti ordre ti sujet na verbe na aphrase ota so.
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s1.prompt: Tënë wa ayeke tâ, na sara na règle so a wara na acas?
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s1.o.a: Na sujet ti nom, verbe asi kozo, na sujet ti pronom, ordre angbâ tongana
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s1.o.b: Tongana adverbe ti ndo asi kozo, verbe asi kozo ti sujet ngbâ
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s1.r.b: Na sujet ti pronom tongana Here it comes, ordre ati nde pëpe.
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s1.o.c: Zia do ngbâ pekoni ti adverbe ti ndo
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s1.r.c: Ayeke gi comes na rolled, ayeke do pëpe.
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s1.o.d: Atâa tongana adverbe ti ndo asi kozo, ordre angbâ tongana ngbâ
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s1.r.d: Na Here comes the bus, verbe asi kozo ti sujet.
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s1.explain: Tongana adverbe ti ndo asi kozo, sujet ti nom aga pekoni ti verbe, me sujet ti pronom tongana it angbâ kozo ti verbe.
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s2.model.0: the bus na the ball aga pekoni ti verbe na it angbâ kozo ti verbe, ni la so sujet ayeke nom wala pronom asara nde.
l-e-h2-b04-11.s.s2.model.1: Here comes the bus na Here it comes asara na adverbe tongana, me sujet ti pronom a sara inversion pëpe, ni la règle so ayeke tâ.

l-e-h2-b04-12.title: Nde ti would have, could have, na might have
l-e-h2-b04-12.goal: Wara na fa règle ti verbe ti aide na proposition ti résultat ti hypothèse ti passé na ndö ti acas mingi, na bâ règle na cas ti sika.
l-e-h2-b04-12.material: If I had left earlier, I would have caught the bus. (tâ-tâ would have caught it) / ..., I could have caught it. (would have been able to catch it) / ..., I might have caught it. (might have caught it) Wara règle.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.o.a: Averbe ti aide ota kue ayeke na sens tongana
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.r.a: Asens so ayeke na yâ ti parenthèse ayeke nde na ti mbeni.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.o.b: would ayeke tâ, could ayeke possible, might ayeke tâ pëpe
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.o.c: would ayeke tâ pëpe na might ayeke résultat so ayeke tâ
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.r.c: would ayeke tâ na might ayeke tâ pëpe.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.o.d: could afa résultat so ayeke tâ
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.r.d: could ayeke possibilité, na résultat so ayeke tâ ayeke would.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.explain: Na hypothèse ti passé, would have afa résultat so ayeke tâ, could have afa ye so ayeke possible, na might have afa résultat so ayeke tâ pëpe.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s2.model.0: would afa tâ-tâ would have caught it, could afa would have been able to catch it, na might afa might have caught it, ni la verbe ti aide afa so résultat ayeke tâ tongana nye.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s2.model.1: Atâa na proposition ti if tongana, asens so ayeke na yâ ti parenthèse ayeke nde, ni la verbe ti aide na proposition ti résultat asara degré ti certitude ati nde.

l-e-h2-b04-13.material: transport (ti mû na ndo ti nde) / import (ti mû na yâ) / export (ti tomba na ndö) / portable (ti lingbi ti mû). Wara sens ti port na yâ ti amot so.

l-e-h2-b04-13.s.s2.model.1: Import aporter ye na yâ na export aporter ye na dehors, ndali ni port ayeke na sens commun tî porter.

l-e-h2-b05-11.title: Règle tî ordre tî anzo na pekoni tî "as did" ayeke nyen?
l-e-h2-b05-11.goal: Bâ exemples mingi tî ordre tî anzo na pekoni tî "as", so afa "nga", gi règle, tene ni, na vérifier ni na cas nouveau.
l-e-h2-b05-11.material: Wages rose, as did prices. / Cats like fish, as do dogs. / The first test was hard, as was the second. Gi règle tî ordre tî anzo na pekoni tî "as" na yâ tî exemples so.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.o.a: Tongana verbe aga kozo tî sujet, ni afa "nga"
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.o.b: Na pekoni tî "as", sara kua ngbii kûê na "do"
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.r.b: "As was the second" asara kua na "was".
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.o.c: Na pekoni tî "as", sujet aga kozo
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.r.c: Na "as did prices", verbe "did" aga kozo.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.o.d: Na pekoni tî "as", ye so ayeke contraire tî ye so aga kozo aga
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.r.d: Phrases ota kûê ayeke na même contenu na ndambo tî kozo.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s1.explain: Tongana [verbe auxiliaire wala verbe be + sujet] aga na pekoni tî "as", tongana "did prices", "do dogs", na "was the second", ni afa "nga".
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s2.model.0: Na exemples ota kûê, verbe aga kozo tî sujet na pekoni tî "as" na afa "nga", ndali ni ordre tî anzo so ayeke règle.
l-e-h2-b05-11.s.s2.model.1: Did, do, na was achanger tî alingbi na verbe na phrase tî kozo, ndali ni na pekoni tî "as" mo piquer verbe tî kozo na inverter.

l-e-h2-b05-12.goal: Bâ exemples mingi tî fait so "verbe modal + have p.p." afa, gi règle, tene ni, na vérifier ni na cas nouveau.
l-e-h2-b05-12.material: I should have called. (acalled ape) / You shouldn't have worried. (aworry) / We could have won. (agagner ape) / We needn't have hurried. (ahurry) Gi règle so ala kûê ayeke na ni.
l-e-h2-b05-12.s.s1.o.a: Ni atene ye so asi tâ na passé, tongana ni ayeke
l-e-h2-b05-12.s.s1.r.a: Ni atene contraire tî fait na yâ tî parenthèses.
l-e-h2-b05-12.s.s1.o.b: Ni aprédire ye so yeke si na futur
l-e-h2-b05-12.s.s1.r.b: Ala kûê atene na ndö tî ye so ahon awe.
l-e-h2-b05-12.s.s1.o.c: Ni atene ye so asi na lâ so
l-e-h2-b05-12.s.s1.o.d: Ni atene contraire tî ye so asi tâ na passé
l-e-h2-b05-12.s.s1.explain: "Should have p.p." atene "alingbi tî sara ni me asara ni ape", na "could have p.p." atene "alingbi tî me asara ni ape", ndali ni ala adécrire passé so ayeke nde na réalité.
l-e-h2-b05-12.s.s2.model.0: Ni atene "should have called" atâa tongana zo acall ape, na "should not have worried" atâa tongana zo aworry, ndali ni ayeke passé contraire tî ye so asi tâ.

l-e-h2-b03-18.material: Aphrases ota-oko: ①If I were a pilot, I would fly. ②If it rains, we will stay in. ③I wish I had a dog. ④If I find it, I will call. ⑤If I had known, I would have helped.
l-e-h2-b03-18.s.s1.prompt: Aphrases nyen afa mbeni situation imaginée so ayeke contre fait?

l-e-h2-b03-18.s.s1.r.b: Mo zia mbeni phrase imaginaire oko.
l-e-h2-b03-18.s.s1.r.d: Mo kaï nga aconditionnels ti présent ②④ tongana imaginaires.
l-e-h2-b03-18.s.s1.explain: ①③⑤ a sara kua na were, had, na had known, ni la ala ayeke contre fait. ②④ ayeke aconditionnels ti présent so alingbi ti si tâ.
l-e-h2-b03-18.s.s2.model.0: ①③⑤ ayeke aphrases imaginaires so a sara kua na were, passé, na passé parfait, ni la ala ayeke 3, na ②④ ayeke aconditionnels ti présent.
l-e-h2-b03-18.s.s2.model.1: ②④ ayeke na présent na alingbi ti si tâ, ni la gï aphrases 3 ayeke contre fait.

l-e-h2-b04-16.s.s2.model.1: Tongana a arrondir 450 na 500, 1/5 tî 500 ayeke 100, ndali ni 90, so ayeke vuko na 100, ayeke juste.

l-e-h2-b04-17.goal: Estimer mingi tongana nyen tî texte mo lingbi tî lire na confort tî décider grandeur wala étendue so alingbi, na fa raisonnement tî mo.
l-e-h2-b04-17.material: Tongana anzo so a hînga ala ape ayeke 5% wala kêtê tî texte, a tene so ayeke confortable tî lire. Texte ayeke na anzo 30 so a hînga ala ape na yâ tî anzo 400. Estimer so a lingbi tî lire ni na confort wala pëpe.

l-e-h2-b04-17.s.s1.o.d: Difficile: approximativement 15% anzo so a hînga ala ape
l-e-h2-b04-17.s.s1.r.d: 15% alingbi tî ayeke anzo 60. Anzo 30 ayeke approximativement 7.5%.
l-e-h2-b04-17.s.s1.explain: 5% tî 400 ayeke anzo 20, na 30 ayeke mingi ahon ni. Ni ayeke approximativement 7.5%, ndali ni ayeke texte difficile.

l-e-h2-b04-17.s.s2.model.1: Tongana a diviser 30 na 400 ni amû approximativement 7.5%, so ayeke kota ahon standard tî 5%, ndali ni ayeke texte difficile.

l-e-h2-b01-27.goal: Gbu sika négation partielle na tënë ti nde (équation, tableau, image, wala tënë), na fa ndali ti nye sens ayeke tongana.
l-e-h2-b01-27.material: E ye ti gbu sika ni na sens tongana na 'Not all the voters supported the plan.'
l-e-h2-b01-27.s.s1.r.a: 'No one supported it' ayeke tënë so ayeke ngangu ahon.
l-e-h2-b01-27.s.s1.r.b: 'All opposed it' ayeke tënë so ayeke ngangu ahon.
l-e-h2-b01-27.s.s1.r.c: Ni atene ti gä, ayeke ti mä bê wala pëpe.
l-e-h2-b01-27.s.s1.explain: Not all afa 'azo kue pëpe', ni la ndö ti azo kete amä bê pëpe.
l-e-h2-b01-27.s.s2.model.0: Not all ayeke négation partielle so afa so azo kue amä bê pëpe, ni la ni ayeke tongana na tënë so azo kete amä bê pëpe.
l-e-h2-b01-27.s.s2.model.1: Tene so zo oko pëpe amä bê ayeke ngangu mingi, ni la phrase so atene so azo kete amä bê pëpe ayeke na sens tongana.

l-e-h2-b01-28.title: Gbu sika regret na wish
l-e-h2-b01-28.goal: Gbu sika tënë ti regret tongana phrase ti wish na fason ti nde (équation, tableau, image, wala tënë), na fa ndali ti nye sens ayeke tongana.
l-e-h2-b01-28.material: E ye ti gbu sika 'I am sorry that I did not call you.' na wish ti ni ayeke na sens tongana.
l-e-h2-b01-28.s.s1.r.a: Ye ti nde na ye ti tâ ti passé ayeke fason ti passé pëpe me passé antérieur.
l-e-h2-b01-28.s.s1.r.b: will ayeke regret pëpe me espérance ti tongo.
l-e-h2-b01-28.s.s1.r.c: Ni yeke na sens ti nde, ti regret so mo apeler.
l-e-h2-b01-28.s.s1.explain: Tongana mo mä désolé na ye so mo sara pëpe na passé, sara na had + participe passé pekoni ti wish. Ni ayeke I wish I had called you.
l-e-h2-b01-28.s.s2.model.0: Ni afa regret ti kpa ti appeler, ni la mo lingbi ti sara na passé antérieur had called pekoni ti wish.
l-e-h2-b01-28.s.s2.model.1: Ni ayeke ye ti ye so mo sara pëpe na tâ na passé, ni la I wish I had called you ayeke na sens tongana.

l-e-h2-b01-29.title: Gbu sika na mot ti -less
l-e-h2-b01-29.goal: Gbu sika 'of no use' tongana mot oko na fason ti nde (équation, tableau, image, wala tënë), na fa ndali ti nye sens ayeke tongana.
l-e-h2-b01-29.material: E ye ti ndoye 'The old key was of no use.' agä mot oko so angbâ na sens tongana: The old key was ___.
l-e-h2-b01-29.s.s1.r.a: user ayeke nom so afa 'zo so asara na ye oko'.
l-e-h2-b01-29.s.s1.r.c: -ful afa 'ayeke na ... mingi', ni la ni amû sens ti nde.
l-e-h2-b01-29.s.s1.r.d: used afa 'a sara na ni awe'.
l-e-h2-b01-29.s.s1.explain: of no use afa so ni ayeke na use pëpe, na use + -less ayeke useless, so afa 'na use pëpe'.
l-e-h2-b01-29.s.s2.model.0: -less afa 'na ... pëpe', ni la useless, so ayeke use na -less, ayeke na sens tongana na of no use.
l-e-h2-b01-29.s.s2.model.1: useful ayeke na sens ti nde, so afa so ni ayeke useful, ni la mo lingbi ti fa mot ti -less so asara sens ti useless.

l-e-h2-b01-30.title: No matter what na ôko mot
l-e-h2-b01-30.goal: Réécrire 'no matter what' na forme kêtê na lege nde (équation, tableau, image, wala anzo), na fa ndali wa sens ayeke même.
l-e-h2-b01-30.material: E aye tî changer 'No matter what you decide, I will help.' na phrase so acommencer na expression tî ôko mot so ayeke na même sens.
l-e-h2-b01-30.s.s1.r.a: Whenever afa 'ngbii kûê', ndali ni ayeke na sens tî temps.
l-e-h2-b01-30.s.s1.r.c: Wherever afa 'ndo kûê', ndali ni ayeke na sens tî ndo.
l-e-h2-b01-30.s.s1.r.d: Whoever afa 'zo kûê', ndali ni ayeke nde na what, so ayeke ye.
l-e-h2-b01-30.s.s1.explain: No matter what alingbi tî a changer ni na whatever. Ni ayeke na même sens: whatever you decide, I will help.
l-e-h2-b01-30.s.s2.model.0: No matter what afa 'ye kûê', ndali ni tongana a changer ni na whatever ni amû même sens.
l-e-h2-b01-30.s.s2.model.1: Who, where, na when afa zo, ndo, na temps, ndali ni whatever, so asara kua na what so afa ye, ayeke correct.

l-e-h2-b02-26.title: Ti sû nga na "Only after"
l-e-h2-b02-26.goal: Change sens oko na phrase "Only after" so a kiri ordre ni, tene ni na mbeni fason ti ndeni (tënë, tableau, image, wala mot), na fa ndali so a yeke na sens oko.
l-e-h2-b02-26.material: Mo ye ti sû nga 'I understood only after the test.' tongana phrase so a ndo na "Only after" na a yeke na sens oko.
l-e-h2-b02-26.s.s1.r.b: Ndo ti "did" ayeke sio, ndali ni expression "Only after" a kiri.
l-e-h2-b02-26.s.s1.r.c: Na peko ti "did" mo sara na forme ti base ti verbe, past tense pëpe.
l-e-h2-b02-26.s.s1.r.d: Tongana expression "Only after" a ga kozo, verbe auxiliaire "did" a lingbi ti ga kozo na sujet.
l-e-h2-b02-26.s.s1.explain: Ordre ayeke "Only after" + adverbial + "did" + sujet + forme ti base. Na peko ti "did" mo sara na "understand".
l-e-h2-b02-26.s.s2.model.0: "Only after the test" a ga kozo, ndali ni a lingbi ti zia "did" kozo na sujet "I", na verbe a lingbi ti yeke forme ti base "understand".
l-e-h2-b02-26.s.s2.model.1: "did" a fa past awe, ndali ni verbe na peko ni a lingbi ti yeke forme ti base, na expression "Only after" a kiri pëpe.

l-e-h2-b02-27.title: Ti tene "Few" na mbeni fason ti ndeni
l-e-h2-b02-27.goal: Change tënë na "Few" na mbeni expression ti ndeni, tene ni na mbeni fason ti ndeni (tënë, tableau, image, wala mot), na fa ndali so a yeke na sens oko.
l-e-h2-b02-27.material: Mbeni guide ti événement a tene, na vundu, 'Few people came.' Mo ye ti change ni na ye so a yeke na sens oko.
l-e-h2-b02-27.s.s1.r.b: A yeke na sens so a kiri ni na "Few" ngbii.
l-e-h2-b02-27.s.s1.r.c: "a few" a yeke na sens positif "there were some".
l-e-h2-b02-27.s.s1.r.d: A yeke na sens so a kiri ni na "Few".
l-e-h2-b02-27.s.s1.explain: "Few" a yeke na sens négatif "hardly any". "Hardly anyone" a fa nga "hardly anybody came".
l-e-h2-b02-27.s.s2.model.0: "Few people came" a fa so zo oko a ga pëpe, ndali ni a yeke sens oko na "Hardly anyone came".
l-e-h2-b02-27.s.s2.model.1: "a few" a yeke na sens positif "some people came", ndali ni ye so a yeke sens oko na tënë ti vundu ayeke "Hardly anyone".

l-e-h2-b02-28.title: Ti change "if not" na "unless"
l-e-h2-b02-28.goal: Change "If not" na "unless", tene ni na mbeni fason ti ndeni (tënë, tableau, image, wala mot), na fa ndali so a yeke na sens oko.
l-e-h2-b02-28.material: Mo ye ti change 'If you do not study, you will fail.' na "unless" ti a yeke na sens oko.
l-e-h2-b02-28.s.s1.r.a: Tongana mo sara na "not" nga na yâ ti "unless", a ga double négatif.
l-e-h2-b02-28.s.s1.r.b: A yeke na sens so a kiri ni na tënë ti kozo.
l-e-h2-b02-28.s.s1.r.c: Temps andoye agä passé, ni la sens ayeke nde na ti kozo.
l-e-h2-b02-28.s.s1.explain: unless afa "if ... not", ni la mo gbu not na tele ti ni pëpe. Unless you study, you will fail ayeke na sens tongana.
l-e-h2-b02-28.s.s2.model.0: unless ayeke na sens tongana na if not, ni la mo lingbi ti gbu Unless you study na not pëpe ti ayeke na sens tongana.
l-e-h2-b02-28.s.s2.model.1: Tongana not ti nde ayeke na yâ ti unless, sens akiri, ni la gbu ni na not pëpe na angbâ na temps tongana ni ayeke.

l-e-h2-b01-31.s.s1.explain: Règle tî vérifier adverbe négatif na kozo mingi amû kiri même na zo kûê. Sentiment ayeke nde na zo na zo.

l-e-h2-b01-32.s.s1.explain: Données afa gï so temps tî sommeil na scores ayeke mingi na ôko. A lingbi tî hînga cause gï tongana a tester facteurs nde.
l-e-h2-b01-32.s.s2.model.0: A atester facteurs nde ape, ndali ni A, so atene so ayeke cause, ayeke ngangu ahon données, na B ayeke alingbi ahon.
l-e-h2-b01-32.s.s2.model.1: B atene gï relation so données afa, ndali ni ayeke meilleur résumé so abata na yâ tî étendue tî preuve.

l-e-h2-b06-33.goal: Kaï alege use ti tene ye so mbeni article afa na lege ti hint, sa choix ti mot so alingbi, na fa raison.
l-e-h2-b06-33.material: Article atene ni kâ kâ ape me afa na lege ti hint so prix alingbi ti kpa. A: The article implied prices would rise. B: The article inferred prices would rise.

l-e-h2-b06-33.s.s1.o.b: B: infer afa so texte afa mbeni ye na lege ti hint

l-e-h2-b06-33.s.s1.r.c: Amots use ayeke sio: oko ayeke ti zo so atene tënë na oko ayeke ti zo so alire.
l-e-h2-b06-33.s.s1.explain: imply ayeke tongana zo so atene tënë afa mbeni ye na lege ti hint, na infer ayeke tongana zo so aë wala alire awara ni na ahint.
l-e-h2-b06-33.s.s2.model.0: Oko so afa na lege ti hint ayeke article, ni la A, so asara kua na imply, ayeke tâ.
l-e-h2-b06-33.s.s2.model.1: infer ayeke ye so zo so alire asara, ni la B, so asara kua na article tongana sujet, aga étrange.

l-e-h2-b07-04.title: Mbeni phrase ti notice poli sans if
l-e-h2-b07-04.topic: Mbeni conditionnel so akamata na Should
l-e-h2-b07-04.goal: Ti phrase ti condition na avis so a sara na politesse, bâ na bê ti mo condition kue so akpa tele ti ala, fa compromis so ayeke nzoni mingi, na fa ndali.
l-e-h2-b07-04.material: Komande 'Please call us if you need help' na anglais. Condition: ① Sara na if pëpe ② Fa ni tongana ye so alingbi ti si ③ Ni ayeke avis ti politesse.
l-e-h2-b07-04.s.s1.r.a: Ni asara na if, ni la ni akpa ① pëpe.
l-e-h2-b07-04.s.s1.r.c: Ni afa ye so alingbi ti si pëpe mingi, ni la ni alingbi na ② kete.
l-e-h2-b07-04.s.s1.r.d: Ni ayeke hypothèse ti passé, ni la ni alingbi na ② pëpe, so atene ndali ti kekereke.
l-e-h2-b07-04.s.s1.explain: Should you need ... afa ye so alingbi ti si na politesse, na if pëpe. Were you to a sara na ni ti ye so alingbi ti si pëpe.
l-e-h2-b07-04.s.s2.model.0: Ni akomanse na Should you need na if pëpe na afa na politesse ye so alingbi ti si na kekereke, ni la ni amä condition ota kue.
l-e-h2-b07-04.s.s2.model.1: A sara na Were you to ti ye so alingbi ti si pëpe, ni la Should you ayeke choix ti tâ ti hunda aide so asi mingi.
